title: TCL 55C815 (EU/Denmark, 2020), `ro.product.model` BeyondTV2, device BeyondTV, board `rtd285o`
notes:
TCL 55C815 (EU/Denmark, 2020), `ro.product.model` BeyondTV2, device BeyondTV, board `rtd285o`
(Realtek), Android TV 11 (API 30), build PPR1.180610.011 / incremental AR05, dated 2023-04-07,
security patch 2021-12-05, 32-bit (`armeabi-v7a`), locale da-DK. ro.adb.secure=1.
Fingerprint: TCL/BeyondTV2/BeyondTV:11/PPR1.180610.011/AR05:user/release-keys
Same firmware family as examples/tcl-50ep680 and the same product name as
examples/tcl-beyondtv2-latin-america (that one is Android 9).

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/tcl-55c815/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/tcl-55c815/debloat.txt
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.tvlauncher (Android TV, not Google TV). Other HOME claimants:
com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice/.FallbackHome and com.android.tv.settings/.system.FallbackHome.
Live TV app: com.tcl.tv, with com.tcl.tvinput for the tuner and HDMI.

Already disabled at the factory: the 14 uk.co.freeview.* catch-up apps, au.com.stan.and,
tv.wuaki.apptv, com.tcl.smartalexa, com.tcl.notereminder, com.tcl.tv.tclhome_master,
com.google.android.music, com.google.android.apps.nbu.smartconnect.tv.

Deliberately NOT disabled:
com.tcl.guard                  # PERSISTENT system app, also runs a package installer service
com.tcl.partnercustomizer      # owns the remote's TKey activities (load-bearing per BeyondTV2 profile)
com.tcl.useragreement          # setup screens + shop-reset receiver
com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith  # owns a saved Wi-Fi network on this unit: disabling it
# would delete that network and drop the TV off Wi-Fi
com.tcl.tv com.tcl.tvinput com.tcl.autopair com.tcl.keycustomfunctionservice com.tcl.settings
com.tcl.inputmethod.international com.tcl.initsetup com.tcl.factory.view com.tcl.providers.config
com.tcl.systemserver com.tcl.micmanager com.tcl.usercenter com.tcl.xian.StartandroidService
Kept by the owner's choice: voice (katniss, tv.assistant, tcl.assistant), Chromecast (mediashell),
mirroring (tcl.miracast, MultiScreenInteraction_TV), firmware updates (versionUpdateApp),
YouTube Music, and every streaming app (Netflix, Max, YouTube, TV 2 Play, DR TV, Prime Video,
Spotify, Viaplay, Apple TV).

Testing: applied on a real unit on 2026-10-20 in four batches with a screenshot after each. The
stock source menu, a YouTube video (through AdGuard Private DNS), the launcher's Inputs menu
(HDMI 1-3, AV, Live TV; HDMI 1 switched via com.tcl.tvinput passthrough), a dock launch, and the
real remote's Home, mic and Source buttons all worked. After a reboot all 18 stayed disabled
(esticker included), Home stayed on the launcher and Wi-Fi came back. Not lived with for days yet.
Launcher quirk: the Wi-Fi pill shows "Wi-Fi", not the network name, while Location is off
(location_mode 0 here); that's Android hiding the SSID, not the launcher's permission.
